GET vs POST forms
GET form data is encoded in the URL query; POST form data is sent in the request body. GET
should be used for safe retrieval.
GET form එJකේ data URL query එකට යනවා. POST එJකේ data request body එකට යනවා.
Search uses GET; signup uses POST.
1 GET: form →URL query · 2 POST: form →request body · 3 HTTPS →protects transport
Read the numbered stages from top to bottom. GET: form → URL query; HTTPS → protects transport.

<form action="/search" method="get">
 <input name="q" aria-label="Search">
 <button>Search</button>
</form>
<form action="/signup" method="post">
 <input name="email" type="email" aria-label="Email">
 <button>Register</button>
</form>
Expected result: Search for shoes: /search?q=shoes. Signup sends email in body.
Interview question: Is POST automatically secure?
Answer: No. HTTPS and secure server-side processing are still required.
Practice: Compare GET and POST in browser Network tools.
